before: Runs with w:fitText keep their natural width, so a fitted phrase can wrap onto an extra line.
after: Consecutive runs that share one w:fitText id take the stated width; text typed into the group joins it and fits again, and text typed right after its last character starts a run without w:fitText.
reason: Layout changes, and typing right after a fitted group writes a new run through the existing insertText operation. Source ranges, operation shapes, and collaboration formats remain unchanged.
